About our brand and products:

GreaterT is a men's health DTC brand for men in their 30s and beyond who can feel something has shifted and aren't willing to call it "just aging." We're not a pill company, we're a foundation company. Our flagship product, Foundation, is a natural testosterone-support supplement built on clinical doses, paired with a free Foundation Course (12 modules) and a private Skool community (the GreaterT Tribe). The bottle is the entry point. The system is what changes lives. Made in the USA in a cGMP facility, third-party tested at an ISO 17025 accredited lab. 60 capsules, $49 MSRP, 30-day supply.

What makes us different:

Most T-support supplements use label dressing: 1-2mg boron, 5mg of "ashwagandha extract," unspecified Tongkat Ali. We don't. Foundation is built on premium ingredients at research-supported doses:

  • Shoden(R) Ashwagandha 120mg (35% withanolide glycosides, by Arjuna Natural). Higher concentration than the more commonly-used alternative.
  • Boron 10mg (the dose actually studied, not the 1-2mg most brands use)
  • Tongkat Ali 200mg
  • Shilajit 500mg standardized to 50% fulvic acid
  • Zinc paired with copper (so customers don't deplete one while supplementing the other)
  • Vitamin D3 5,000 IU with Vitamin K2 MK-7 120mcg

We also wrap the product in a system. The Foundation Course and the Tribe community come free with every order. Founder-led brand, real names on the bottle, COAs published openly. The differentiation isn't fairy-dust marketing. It's clinical dosing, transparent sourcing, and a community that holds men accountable to the protocol.

How affiliates can earn:

  • 30% commission on every initial order
  • 15% commission on subscription recurring orders (most customers reorder, and you get paid every month they stay subscribed)
  • 60-day cookie window
  • $0 minimum payout
  • AOV: $49 single bottle, higher on 3-packs and subscriptions

The real money is in subscriptions. Foundation is built for daily use over 90+ days, which is when men actually feel the difference. Strong reorder behavior means recurring commission for you, not a one-and-done payout.

How to promote us:

Best-fit audiences:

  • Men's health and longevity creators
  • Fitness, strength, and performance niches
  • Biohacking and functional medicine
  • Podcasters in the men's space
  • Reddit communities and forums where men talk honestly about T, sleep, recovery, and energy

Content angles that work:

  • Ingredient deep-dives (boron dosing, why D3 needs K2, what 50% fulvic Shilajit actually means)
  • "Modern life is crushing your T, not your age"
  • The natural-first option for men not yet considering TRT
  • The system approach (it's not just a pill, it's a 90-day protocol with a community)
  • Founder-led story, real lab work, transparent dosing

Approved partners get access to a creative library, ingredient one-pagers, and founder video clips ready to repurpose. Active partners also get early access to new content drops and product launches.

Promotion requirements:

  • Clear FTC affiliate disclosure on every post
  • Structure/function language only: "supports" testosterone, "supports" energy. Never "boosts," "treats," "cures," or "raises." These claims violate FDA rules and put both of us at risk.
  • No medical advice, no positioning Foundation as a substitute for prescription TRT

Other information:

  • Made in the USA, cGMP-manufactured, third-party tested at an ISO 17025 accredited lab
  • 30-day money-back guarantee
  • Subscription program is live, which is where the long-term affiliate value sits
  • Currently ships within the US (international handled by exception)
  • Application-based program. We review for brand fit, not just follower count. We'd rather have 50 aligned partners than 500 random ones.
  • Founder-led, two-person team. Partner messages get personal responses from us.

Apply at greatert.com/pages/affiliate
